acid.x: Add a claw to your roll every turn, even when you roll none.

cosmic.x: Power cards cost you 1 energy less.

alpha.x: Gain 1 star on every turn you roll at least one claw.

plated.x: You lose no hearts when you would lose exactly 1 heart.

lurker.x: You can always reroll any of your 3s, even after your last roll.

tunnel.x: Add a claw to your roll while you are in the city. When you yield the city, the monster taking your place loses 1 heart.

chameleon.x: When you lose hearts, roll a die for each one. Every heart rolled saves 1 of them.

spree.x: If your dice show 1, 2, 3, heart, claw and energy, gain 9 stars as well.

news.x: Gain 1 star whenever you buy a power card.

carrion.x: Gain 3 stars every time a monster drops to 0 hearts.

battery.x: At the end of your turn, gain 1 star for every 6 energy you hold.

growth.x: Heal 2 when you buy this. Your maximum hearts go up by 2.

scorch.x: When you roll at least one claw, the monsters seated next to you lose 1 extra heart.

hiccup.x: On a turn you roll three or more 1s, take another turn afterwards with one die fewer (one fewer again each time it repeats).

kidfan.x: Whenever you gain energy, gain 1 more.

brain.x: You get one extra reroll each turn.

gourmand.x: When you roll three or more 1s, gain 2 extra stars.

healray.x: You may spend your heart dice to heal other monsters. Each pays you 2 energy per heart it gains (1 if that is its last energy).

grazer.x: Gain 1 star at the end of your turn if you made nobody lose hearts.

pack.x: Once per turn, turn one of your dice into a 1.

egg.x: If you are knocked out, discard all your cards, lose all your stars, leave the city and hatch again with 10 hearts.

vjets.x: You lose no hearts when you choose to yield the city.

lab.x: In your buy step you may peek at the top card of the deck, then buy it or put it back.

meta.x: At the end of your turn you may discard any of your Keep cards to gain their full cost in energy.

mimic.x: Pick a Keep card any monster has: this card copies it. At the start of your turn you may pay 1 energy to copy a different one.

cell.x: When you buy this, put 6 energy from the bank on it. At the start of your turn move 2 of them to your pool. Discard it when it is empty.

nova.x: Your claws hit every other monster, wherever they are.

omni.x: When you roll at least one 1, one 2 and one 3, gain 2 stars. Those dice still count for other sets.

opp.x: Whenever a new power card is turned face up, you may buy it at once, before anyone else.

para.x: You may buy Keep cards from other monsters, paying the owner their cost.

twist.x: Before resolving, you may turn one die to any face. Then discard this card.

quills.x: When you roll three or more 2s, add two claws to your roll.

pspit.x: Each monster your claws hit gets a poison token. A monster loses 1 heart per poison token at the end of its turn. A heart die can remove one token instead of healing.

probe.x: After each other monster’s last roll you may reroll one of its dice. If it comes up a heart, discard this card.

mend.x: At any time, pay 2 energy to heal 1 heart, even to avoid being knocked out.

regrow.x: Whenever you gain hearts, gain 1 extra.

underdog.x: At the end of your turn, if you have the fewest stars, gain 1 star.

shrink.x: Each monster your claws hit gets a shrink token. A monster rolls 1 die fewer per shrink token. A heart die can remove one token instead of healing.

smoke.x: Comes with 3 puffs. Spend a puff for an extra reroll. Discard it when they are gone.

sun.x: At the end of your turn, if you have no energy, gain 1.

barbed.x: When you roll at least one claw, add another claw to your roll.

rubber.x: Before resolving, you may pay 2 energy to turn one die to any face.

mind.x: Pay 1 energy for an extra reroll.

street.x: Gain 1 extra star when you start your turn in the city. In the city, if you roll at least one claw, add another claw.

thick.x: Whenever you lose 2 or more hearts at once, gain 1 energy.

wings.x: When you would lose hearts, you may pay 2 energy: you lose no hearts for the rest of that turn.

skydive.x: Gain 2 stars and take over Downtown. Every other monster in the city must leave it.

rush.x: Take another turn after this one.

refinery.x: Gain 2 stars. Every other monster loses 3 hearts.

carpet.x: Every monster, you included, loses 3 hearts.

cyclone.x: Gain 2 stars. Every other monster loses 1 energy for every 2 it holds.

m_free.x: You cannot buy this while you hold a Mindbug token. You get 1 extra reroll each turn.

m_evade.x: Use this card as a Mindbug token. After using it, give it to the monster you Mindbugged.

m_nobrain.x: Costs 2 energy more for each Mindbug token you hold. Add a claw to your roll every turn.

m_dysf.x: Every monster holding at least 1 Mindbug token, you included, loses 3 hearts.

m_treas.x: Buy a consumable card from the discard pile for 3 energy less.

m_mirac.x: Buy this only with 3 hearts or fewer. Lose all your stars, go back to 10 hearts and gain 1 Mindbug token.

m_petal.x: POISON. The attacker also loses 1 star for each heart you lost.

m_cryst.x: POISON. If you are knocked out this turn, the attacker loses twice the hearts you lost.

m_whip.x: POISON. The attacker also loses 1 energy for each heart you lost.

m_maxe.x: FRENZY. After your Frenzy turn, roll 1 die fewer for the rest of the game.

612.x: When you drop to 0 hearts you are not knocked out: gain 3 hearts, then roll 1 die fewer for the rest of the game. Then discard this card.

EXPS.d: Each monster has its own 8 evolution cards. Start with one; whenever you resolve three hearts, pick another. Keep them secret and play them when their text allows.
Resolve four of a kind to gain a cultist (one per face). Spend one on your turn for a heart, an energy or an extra reroll.
If you are already in the city, resolve four 1s to climb a level of the Tower. Levels 1 and 2 give hearts and energy each turn. Reaching the top wins at once.
Resolve four claws to go berserk and roll the berserk die too. Healing with hearts calms you down.
Each three 1s gives 2 wickedness and each three 2s gives 1 (up to 10). At 3, 6 and 10 take a wicked tile.
Everyone starts in a costume with a power. Smash a monster with 3+ claws to buy its costume off its back.
A curse changes the rules for everyone. The Die of Fate can swap it, punish you or bless you, and the Golden Scarab protects its holder from some curses.
